releases.new: Recognize TypeVar, ParamSpec, NewType and similar definitions whose names are only known at runtime, warning that the name cannot be verified.
releases.breaking: The mismatched-type-name rule is replaced by eight rules; update configuration, CLI flags and suppression comments to use the rule for each constructor.

releases.new: Show progress and handle Ctrl-C during the initial file indexing in the language server preview.
Add a project-manager script setting that can be set to uv for script environments.
releases.breaking: Incompatible TypeIs narrowings now report under two new rules, so update any ignore comments or rule configuration for the old rule.

releases.new: Update imports automatically when renaming Python package folders in the language server.
releases.breaking: Some diagnostics moved to new rules, so update any ignore or severity settings for import-not-found, dataclass post-init, or TypeVar constraints.

releases.new: Resolve pytest fixtures registered through pytest_plugins in the language server.

releases.breaking: The invalid-return-type rule is split into three rules and several rules are renamed, so update any ty configuration or suppressions that name them.
